interpretation: The tightest cap on task_0010 root two changes 1115 of 4200 actions but remains unsafe unfinished, first violating all_stack_upright at observation 997 while target_upright remains true. The task_0013 root-one identity control is safe unfinished. Neither has its complete same-scene/root set of comparisons yet; do not rank conditions from these partial results. Costs in the batch audit include recorded partial work, whose process status does not itself prove liveness.
additional_interpretation: The 0.06/0.04 cap on task_0013 root two changes 82 actions and the 0.01/0.01 cap on task_0013 root zero changes 1321. Both remain safe unfinished after 4200 actions. Their same-scene/root unchanged controls have not completed; no relative benefit is established.
first_complete_scene_seed_comparison: Task_0013 root zero: identity and 0.01/0.01 cap both remain safe unfinished after 4200 actions and 525 queries, with no held target. The cap changes 1321 commands. There is no completion gain in this pair; separate starts prevent exact causal attribution.
additional_completed_trial: Task_0010 root one with 0.06/0.04 cap remains unsafe unfinished, changes 148 commands, never holds the target, and first violates all_stack_upright at observation 1943 while target_upright remains true. Its same-scene/root control is pending.
two_completed_scene_seed_comparisons: Task_0013 roots zero and one: identity and the 0.01/0.01 cap both remain safe unfinished after 4200 actions and 525 queries, without a held target. No safe-completion gain, loss or violation-count change in these two descriptive comparisons; four other planned comparisons for that cap remain incomplete.
tight_cap_all_bowl_roots: The 0.01/0.01 cap has completed all three task_0013 root seeds: roots zero and one are safe unfinished, root two is unsafe unfinished. Root two changes 1378 commands, never holds the target and first violates all_stack_upright and target_upright at observation 1834. Its matching identity trial is still pending.
early_unsafe_completion: Task_0010 root two with the 0.06/0.04 cap completes unsafely at 695 actions; its first stack-upright violation occurs at observation 148 while the target remains upright. It changes 44 commands and records zero aperture-based grasp-evidence proposals despite eventually holding the target. This is no safe-completion gain; the same-scene/root identity trial is pending.
middle_cap_observed_safety_loss: Task_0013 root one: 0.03/0.02 cap changes 254 commands and is unsafe unfinished, first violating both stack and target uprightness at observation 3237. Its identity control is safe unfinished. Neither ever holds the target. This is an adverse outcome contrast from separate physical starts, not a causal attribution to the cap.
all_caps_bowl_root_two: All three cap settings have finished task_0013 root two: the 0.01/0.01 cap is unsafe unfinished, while 0.03/0.02 and 0.06/0.04 are safe unfinished. The middle cap changes 663 commands. No run holds the target or completes. Identity remains pending.
